title: Business Meeting
description: Practice sharing updates, asking questions, and responding in a work meeting.
descriptionZh: 练习在英文会议中汇报进展、提问和回应。

context.setting: A weekly project meeting with a small cross-functional team.
context.learnerPurpose: Share concise updates, clarify blockers, and respond professionally.

constraints: Keep the meeting realistic and concise.
Ask one follow-up question at a time.
Focus on project communication instead of generic small talk.
